[[File:Jaina_Jag_firstkiss.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jagged Fel's uniform displaying the ideal of Red Flame.]]
The '''Red Flame''' was a military symbol used by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|87|Red Flame}}</ref> A [[Color/Legends|red]] piping worn on their military uniforms,<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref> it represented the [[Red Flame]], an ideal state of perfection among their people, being the essence of courage, cunning, and discipline.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
During the [[Battle of Rhigar]]<ref name="RSBF" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Red Sky, Blue Flame]]'' take place in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] [[Shawnkyr Nuruodo]] of the [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy]] wore the symbol on her [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]], as did all the other Chiss [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]]. [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jagged Fel]] wore the [[Blue Flame (symbol)|blue piping]] instead, which Nuruodo noticed. During their conversation in the mechanics bay, Fel noticed the contrast between Shawnkyr's red piping and his own blue piping, which represented a constant reminder that he could never be a Chiss.<ref name="RSBF" /> 

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], all members of the [[Vanguard Squadron (Hapes)|Vanguard Squadron]] wore the symbol on their uniforms.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
